name: E-Commodities Holdings Limited
summary: E-Commodities Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the processing and trading of coal and other products. It operates through two segments, Trading of Coal and Other Products; and Rendering of Integrated Supply Chain Services. The company also offers supply chain trading and technology services; and constructs, manages, and operates mining equipment, processing factories, and logistics parks, as well as renders mining, consigned processing, and logistics services. It operates in the People's Republic of China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mongolia, South Korea, India, Japan, Vietnam, the Netherlands, and internationally.
